seal.statement: PartitionSplitMergeManager owns one bounded deferred-evaluation scheduler whose obligations retain independent due-time eligibility: firing an earlier managed-split retry dispatches only contexts due at that time, keeps a later merge-traffic-span follow-up armed, and vice versa. Equal deadlines coalesce, duplicate logical requests occupy one retained obligation, periodic reset may admit a new pair follow-up only after the prior obligation is serviced, busy or backpressured evaluation continues through the existing requestEvaluation owner, and shutdown cancels the timer and discards all retained obligations. Under periodic-only idle load, repeated unrelated five-second split retries cannot consume the merge pair's sixty-five-second sampling follow-up, so the pair becomes eligible and merges without timeout, cadence, or hysteresis changes.
